description:
Brand Introduction:

Maya is a premium pet supplement brand dedicated to enhancing the health and well-being of pets. Our products are meticulously crafted using high-quality, natural ingredients and backed by scientific research to ensure pets receive the best nutrition and care. With a focus on pet wellness and longevity, Maya supplements are designed to provide essential support for joint health, digestive health, and overall vitality. We believe in transparency, quality, and making a positive difference in the lives of pets and their owners.

Product Description:

Maya offers a range of pet supplements that target key health areas for both dogs and cats. Our formulations include ingredients designed to promote joint mobility, support healthy digestion, improve skin and coat health, and strengthen the immune system. Each product is made from natural, vet-approved ingredients that are safe and effective. We ensure that every supplement is crafted with the utmost care to meet the highest standards of pet nutrition and wellness.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Maya’s unique selling point lies in our commitment to scientifically-backed, natural formulations that are both effective and safe for pets. Our supplements are created with the highest quality ingredients, designed to support various aspects of pet health, from joint care to digestive support. Additionally, Maya products are cruelty-free, free from harmful additives, and tailored to enhance the long-term health and happiness of pets. Our dedication to pet wellness and our use of top-tier ingredients set us apart in the pet supplement market.

Payment Terms:

Our affiliate program offers competitive commission rates, typically ranging from 5% to 10% per sale (adjust based on your specific rate).  Affiliates earn commissions on all qualifying sales made through their unique referral links, with a cookie duration of 30 days, ensuring they receive credit for referred customers within that time frame.

Other Information:

  • Affiliates will have access to a variety of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and detailed product descriptions to help with promotion.
  • Our affiliate support team is available to assist with any questions or guidance needed to optimize performance.
  • Maya values ethical marketing practices and requires affiliates to comply with FTC guidelines on disclosing affiliate relationships.
  • Affiliates can monitor their performance and sales via an intuitive dashboard with real-time analytics.
